description: MWRI-2 on FY-3F (RTTOV FY-3 satellite id 6). The curves are the channel spectral response functions distributed by the EUMETSAT NWP SAF for the RTTOV radiative-transfer model, converted from frequency to wavelength; bands chNN follow the RTTOV channel order.

licence.terms: No terms of use are stated on the NWP SAF SRF pages or in the files. The NWP SAF SRF index lists sensors whose 'SRFs cannot be published due to licence restrictions' separately; this sensor's SRFs are published there.
licence.scope: EUMETSAT NWP SAF distribution of originator data (see notes). Hosted under Nill's 2026-10-26 'host everything' decision.

notes: NWP SAF README_SRF: 'Data obtained from CMA Date received: 23/11/2023 Data available at: https://satellite.nsmc.org.cn/FY3F/html/FY3FAPPDATASET.html Text files contains the frequency (Hz) and the un-normalised spectral responses in dBm' Held, not hosted (curve extends below 15 GHz, beyond the NJM validator limit of 2e8 A): ch01 (10.647 GHz V (ID=3)): curve reaches 10.547 GHz < 14.99 GHz; ch02 (10.643 GHz H (ID=4)): curve reaches 10.546 GHz < 14.99 GHz. Zeros added just inside gaps between separate passbands. Pivots agree with the page's central frequencies within 1% except double-sideband channels, whose pivot lies between the sidebands. DetectorType energy is assumed.
